name: Dungdit and the Giant Garden
shortDescription: Dungdit’s enormous appetite leads him on a colourful journey through fruits, vegetables, grains and other foods, inspiring a giant community garden built on variety, planning and sharing.
longDescription: Dungdit is a friendly giant who works hard but is always hungry. With Nyakuoth and the village growers, he discovers that the answer is not simply more food, but a wider variety of foods grown and prepared thoughtfully. After learning to take responsibility for food he once took from others, Dungdit helps plan, plant and care for a giant community garden filled with millet, vegetables, fruits, beans, roots and other nourishing foods. Together, the community learns about growing food, balanced variety, cooperation and sharing knowledge responsibly.
